name: m3-memory
summary: Give your AI agent a memory — local-first, private, easy to install. Guided setup wizard; works out of the box on your own machine, no cloud. For everyday agent users, homelabs, and developers alike · 99.2% LongMemEval-S retrieval @ k=10 · Works with Claude · Gemini · Antigravity · OpenCode · OpenClaw · Hermes · any MCP agent (native + one-command plugins) · Hybrid search (FTS5 + vector + MMR) · GDPR · FIPS 140-3 deployment-ready · 100% local (fully offline) or cloud capable
